local ThemeNames={"Serenity","Darker","Midnight","Dark","Green","Void","Fire","Coffee","Gray","Rose","Galaxy"}

local function New(c,p) local o=Instance.new(c) for k,v in pairs(p or {}) do if k~="Parent" then o[k]=v end end if p and p.Parent then o.Parent=p.Parent end return o end
local function Round(p,r) return New("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,r or 9),Parent=p}) end
local function Stroke(p,c,t) return New("UIStroke",{Color=c,Transparency=t or .7,Thickness=1,ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,Parent=p}) end
local function Tw(o,d,p) local t=TweenService:Create(o,TweenInfo.new(d or .14,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),p)t:Play()return t end
local function CopyArray(a)local o={} for _,v in ipairs(a or {})do o[#o+1]=v end return o end
local function SelectionSet(a)local o={} if type(a)=="table" then if #a>0 then for _,v in ipairs(a)do o[tostring(v)]=true end else for k,v in pairs(a)do if v then o[tostring(k)]=true end end end end return o end
local function CopyText(v)local e=(getgenv and getgenv()) or _G for _,f in ipairs({e.setclipboard,e.toclipboard,e.writeclipboard,rawget(_G,"setclipboard")})do if type(f)=="function" and pcall(f,tostring(v or "")) then return true end end return false end
local function ParentGui() if gethui then local ok,r=pcall(gethui) if ok and r then return r end end local ok,r=pcall(function()return CoreGui end) if ok and r then return r end return LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end
local function Avatar()local ok,r=pcall(function()local x=Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(LP.UserId,Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot,Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150)return x end)return ok and r or "" end
local function GameIcon()local id=tonumber(game.GameId) or tonumber(game.PlaceId) or 0 return ("rbxthumb://type=GameIcon&id=%d&w=150&h=150"):format(id) end
local function GameName()local ok,r=pcall(function()return MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo(game.PlaceId,Enum.InfoType.Asset)end)return ok and r and r.Name or "Current Experience" end
local function Drag(h,t)local d=false;local s;local p h.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then d=true;s=i.Position;p=t.Position end end) UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)if d and(i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch)then local x=i.Position-s;t.Position=UDim2.new(p.X.Scale,p.X.Offset+x.X,p.Y.Scale,p.Y.Offset+x.Y)end end) UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then d=false end end)end

local Library={Version="14.6-mobile-v3-search",APIVersion=3,RendererKind="Mobile",DiscordInvite=DISCORD}
function Library.Create(opt)
 opt=opt or{};local W=opt.Width or 650;local H=opt.Height or 420;local T=Presets[opt.Theme or"Serenity"] or Presets.Serenity
 local X={Pages={},Nav={},Items={},Features={},Binds={},ShellGlass={},FeatureGlass={},ControlGlass={},Connections={},Cleanups={},ThemeRefreshers={},ActivePopup=nil,Destroyed=false,ThemeName=opt.Theme or"Serenity"}
 local Defaults={Theme=X.ThemeName,BackgroundStyle="Glass",ShellTransparency=14,FeatureTransparency=48,ControlTransparency=34,PremiumMotion=true,ReduceLag=false,Disable3D=false,BlackScreen=false,WhiteScreen=false,AntiAFK=false,NoClip=false,InfiniteJump=false,FPSCap=60,LastPage="Dashboard"}
 for k,v in pairs(opt.DefaultConfig or{})do Defaults[k]=v end
 local C={}for k,v in pairs(Defaults)do C[k]=v end
 local path=opt.ConfigPath or("SerenityHub/config-%s.json"):format(tostring(game.GameId));local saveId=0
 local function fs()return opt.DisableInternalConfig~=true and type(writefile)=="function" and type(readfile)=="function" and type(isfile)=="function" end
 if fs() then pcall(function()if isfile(path)then local d=HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(path))for k,v in pairs(d)do
  if Defaults[k]~=nil then C[k]=v end
 end
 if d.BackgroundTransparency~=nil and d.FeatureTransparency==nil then
  C.FeatureTransparency=math.clamp(tonumber(d.BackgroundTransparency) or 48,30,72)
 end
 end end)end
 local function save()if not fs()then return false end if type(makefolder)=="function"then pcall(makefolder,"SerenityHub")end return pcall(function()writefile(path,HttpService:JSONEncode(C))end)end
 local function later()saveId+=1;local id=saveId;task.delay(.4,function()if id==saveId and not X.Destroyed then save()end end)end
 X.Config=C;X.DefaultConfig=Defaults;X.ConfigPath=path
